designBrief: Warm vinyl-and-wood day-cafe/night-bar concept at Mackenzie Road, Singapore. Palette from the business's own real logo (maroon, cream) and real dark-wood, amber-lit interior. Alegreya (warm, hand-set literary serif echoing their maroon hand-lettered event graphics) for headings, Manrope for body. Single-page, warm and a little mysterious, photography-led. Signature element: an abstracted line-art motif derived from the logo's own 'peeking through fingers' gesture, paired with a matching clip-path 'peek' reveal-on-scroll animation.
